title: retrophyllum piresii
intro: Retrophyllum piresii, commonly known as Pires' wood or Pires' cycad, is a species of plant in the family Podocarpaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress and alleviate symptoms associated with various diseases. The bioactive constituents present in Retrophyllum piresii, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and anti-diabetic effects. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been shown to possess anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a subject of interest for further research in the field of pharmacology.
